# Town of Wolcott municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Wolcott, Annual Town Meeting minutes, March 3, 2026 (read from the town's official site; the site serves a captcha interstitial to direct fetches, so the minutes were read in the browser): Joe Hester-Ingram 'was elected as Moderator for a one year term'. He was a batch-28 straggler; the minutes resolve the seat.

Town of Wolcott, Annual Town Meeting minutes, March 3, 2026 (read from the town's official site; the site serves a captcha interstitial to direct fetches, so the minutes were read in the browser): Lucien Gravel was elected Cemetery Commissioner for a five-year term and Derrick Lowell for a four-year term, completing the five-member commission. The commission's own page lists six names, including Belinda Clegg (the town clerk); the minutes' elected set and the five-seat count leave no seat for her and she is not minted.

Town of Wolcott, Annual Town Meeting minutes, March 3, 2026 (read from the town's official site; the site serves a captcha interstitial to direct fetches, so the minutes were read in the browser): Edith Duff was elected Library Trustee for a five-year term and Nicolette LeRiche for a two-year term (the library's own site styles them 'Edie Duff' and 'Nikki LeRiche'; the minutes' forms govern). The third seat standing in 2026 (one-year) elected no one per the minutes and stays open.
